messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to roll the role_consolidation migration tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need final sign-off on: default role mapping (legacy -> default_role), audit hook placement, and a quick canary for service accounts. :alarm_clock:
liam: Quick Q — does the migration touch KMS-wrapped role blobs? last rotation caused a transient deny. :thinking:
maya: Good call. It will re-encrypt a small set of role_metadata with kms key-2026-prod. We have a preflight that verifies KMS access; if the decrypt check fails we abort. :lock:
devsec-bot: preflight results: kms-access-check: PASS, audit-hook-presence: WARN (some orgs missing audit-json config), db-locks-sim: PASS
sanjay: Re: audit-hook WARN — I found ~120 orgs where audit_sink is null. If we assign default_role observer on write, logs will show implicit grants and that could confuse compliance reviewers. We should insert an explicit audit record for those cases.
olivia: For the service-account canary: we saw a previous migration that re-mapped SA roles when org_id was empty. That produced orphan grants. Can we add a no-op assertion that fails if org_id is NULL?
maya: Yes. Plan: dry-run with flag --infer-legacy-role=false, and fail if any principal.org_id IS NULL. We'll export the offending rows to s3://redwood-migration/role-consolidation/failures/<ts>.
liam: What about backfill window and DB impact? previous backfills caused long lock waits on role_map table. Suggest staging batch_size=500 and run during off-peak. Also add a conditional index re-check.
sanjay: Agreed. Also putting the KV cache invalidation after transaction commit to avoid stale reads: run `UPDATE role_cache SET valid=false WHERE role_id IN (...)` in a separate job.
maya: Adding runnable rollback snippets here:
```
-- rollback: restore pre-migration role_map
INSERT INTO role_map SELECT * FROM role_map_snapshot WHERE snapshot_ts = 'pre-1710910203';
-- invalidate caches
systemctl restart redwood-role-cache || true
```
liam: devsec: can you run one more KMS cross-region decrypt test? last time eu key had a different policy.
devsec-bot: kms-cross-region-decrypt: scheduled (ETA 12m). will post results.
olivia: small ask — can we also tag all changed rows with migration_run_id so audits can filter? helps postmortem if anything odd pops up.
maya: Good idea — we'll add migration_run_id = 'rc-2026-03-xx' and migration_notes JSON summary. I'll hand off final checklist in #eng-oncall at 08:30 PST. :white_check_mark:
liam: :eyes: approved from infra side as long as KMS cross-region passes and batch_size is limited.
sanjay: I'll own the audit records patch and the s3 export hook. If we see >0 NULL org_id rows during dry-run, we stop and file an incident ticket.
maya: Thanks — merging canary plan into release branch now. Will alert if any blocker from preflight.
